common.demoHint: Demo values from the seed. Save your own and the DEMO tag goes away.

errors.REFUND_DUPLICATE: A refund of this amount is already recorded for this booking. Not repeating it.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAID: The amount is more than was received for this booking (minus refunds).
errors.TARIFFS_INVALID: Rates must start at 1 day with no gaps; leave the last row without an upper limit.
errors.PLATE_TAKEN: A bike with this plate or VIN already exists.
errors.IMAGE_INVALID: This file doesn't look like an image. Upload JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Up to 15 MB.
errors.UNKNOWN_KEY: There is no such string in the translations.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: The file didn't upload. Check the connection and try again.
errors.VALIDATION: Check the values: something is filled in incorrectly.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the owner can do this.
errors.TRACKER_TAKEN: This device ID is already linked to another bike.
errors.BIKE_HAS_ACTIVE_BOOKING: This bike has an active booking. Finish it or move it to another bike first.
errors.STAFF_TAKEN: This person already works at another location. An administrator can reassign them.
errors.PAYOS_KEYS_REJECTED: payOS rejected the keys or the notification address. Check that all three keys are from one channel.
errors.PAYMENT_KEYS_SECRET_MISSING: PAYMENT_KEYS_SECRET is not set on the server, so keys cannot be stored safely.

fleet.meta: Models, bikes and brands. Prices and rates are in Prices.
fleet.metaManager: Your location's fleet. Update a bike's status, mileage and service date.

models.emptyText: Add the first model and it appears in the Mini App catalog.
models.noPhotos: No photos — the catalog shows a bike outline.
models.photoHint: JPG, PNG or HEIC up to 15 MB. The server makes WebP and AVIF at 400, 800 and 1200 px.
models.name: Name
models.brandHint: Add a brand on the Brands tab first.
models.depositHint: Returned after the bike is returned.
models.conditionsHint: Deposit, documents, restrictions — shown on the bike page.
models.includedHint: One item per line. EN lines define the list; RU and VI translate the same line.
models.tariffsHint: Rates by duration and seasonal coefficients are in

bikes.emptyText: Add a bike to a model — a model without bikes can't be booked.
bikes.readyAtHint: From this date the bike can be booked again.
bikes.docsPrivate: Files are kept in private storage; a viewing link lasts 10 minutes.
bikes.managerHint: Managers change status, mileage and service date. The owner edits plate, VIN and insurance.

brands.name: Brand name
brands.noLogo: Without a logo the Mini App shows the name.

prices.meta: Mini App prices use these values as soon as you save.
prices.openHint: An empty “To” in the last row means no upper limit.

problem.first: The first row must start at 1 day.
problem.gap: Rows must be continuous: each starts the day after the previous “To”.
problem.price: Every row needs a price above zero.
problem.open: Leave “To” empty in the last row to cover any length.

prices.noSeasonsText: A coefficient multiplies the price only for days inside the season dates.
prices.deleteSeasonConfirm: Delete the season? Prices go back to normal.
prices.extraCodeHint: Latin letters and digits, e.g. HELMET_2.
prices.deliveryHint: Empty — delivery is not offered in the Mini App.

locations.meta: Address, coordinates and hours are shown to clients in bookings and the bot.
locations.name: Name
locations.hoursInvalid: Opening time must be before closing time.
locations.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the location? Admin access will be revoked.
locations.closeConfirm: Close this location? Its bikes leave the catalog; current bookings stay.
locations.contactHint: Telegram or phone of this location. Empty uses the shared contact from settings.
locations.legalNameHint: Name or company and details. Goes into the rental contract.

owners.title: Owner
owners.none: No owner assigned. Only the administrator sees this location.
owners.hint: The owner sends /id to the bot to get this number. They will see only this location.

managers.title: Managers
managers.hint: The manager sends /id to the bot. Managers hand over and take back bikes but do not see amounts.

payos.title: Online payment
payos.clearConfirm: Disconnect this account? New payments will follow the shared settings.
payos.webhookManual: The notification address is not confirmed. It confirms when keys are saved on a server with HTTPS, or enter it in the channel at my.payos.vn:

note.own: Customer money goes straight to this location's bank account.
note.platform: No own keys: this location's money goes to the shared account from the server settings.
note.test: No money is charged: this is test mode.
note.off: Customers cannot pay online until an account is connected.

texts.meta: Documents and edits to any interface string in three languages.

docHint.contractTemplate: Goes into the agreement PDF in the client's language and Vietnamese.
docHint.rulesText: The client accepts them at checkout.
docHint.restrictionsText: Mileage and inter-province travel: shown in the model card “Conditions”.
docHint.privacyText: Linked in the profile and on document upload.
docHint.faq: The FAQ section in the Mini App profile.

texts.stringsText: Edits are layered over the translation files and show in the Mini App after it restarts. Keep curly braces like {code} — values are inserted there.
texts.nothingText: Try another word or clear the section.
texts.placeholdersHint: Keep values in curly braces as they are, or the server won't accept the edit.

payments.meta: Expected vs received, all transactions, deductions and refunds.
payments.noMismatchesText: Everything expected for bookings in the period has been received.
payments.refundText: Record the refund once the money is sent. The client gets a message with the amount.
payments.completeText: Mark it when you've transferred the money. The client gets a message with the amount.
payments.commentHint: For example, the transfer number. Visible in the log.
payments.noDeductionsText: Managers record deposit deductions when taking a bike back.

rub.title: Ruble transfers: {count}
rub.hint: Clients report these transfers. Check the amount and booking code in your bank.
rub.cancelled: The booking is already cancelled: confirming will create a refund record.

settings.meta: Rules apply right after saving — no restart needed.

hint.holdMinutes: How long a VietQR booking waits for payment before it's cancelled.
hint.bufferMinutes: Inspection and washing: the bike stays busy after the booking ends.
hint.minLeadMinutes: Clients can't book closer to pickup. Doesn't limit walk-in bookings made in the admin.
hint.noShowHours: A booking not picked up this many hours after start is cancelled.
hint.docRetentionDays: Documents are deleted this long after the client's last booking.
hint.cashPrepayPercent: 0 — cash without prepayment, the booking is confirmed right away.
hint.managerContact: @username, a t.me link or a phone — for the Contact button.

settings.cancelHint: More than {full} h before pickup — 100% of rent, {half}–{full} h — {percent}%, later — 0. The deposit is always returned in full.
settings.lateHint: After the free grace period — an hourly fee; after the threshold — one more day at the rate.

depositModeHint.MONEY: The model's deposit is added to the payment and returned after the rental.
depositModeHint.DOCUMENT: No money deposit: the client leaves a document at the location.

settings.ratesHint: Used for “≈ ₽ / $” in the Mini App. The rate updates automatically once a day. Saving your own value turns this off until you restore it.
settings.moreHint: Delivery price is in Prices; agreement and rules texts are in Texts.
settings.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
settings.saved: Settings saved and already in effect
settings.ratesManual: The rate is set manually, automatic updates are off.

rub.title: Payment in rubles
rub.hint: Only a client with a booking paid this way sees these details. While the fields are empty, this payment method is off. The money goes to these details, not to the point owner, so settle with the owner separately.
rub.markupHint: Covers the difference when exchanging rubles for dong. The client pays the rate with this markup.

banner.meta: One banner on the Mini App home screen.
banner.title: Title
banner.linkHint: https://…, a Mini App path (/catalog) or tg://. Empty — the banner doesn't open anything.
banner.hiddenHint: The banner is hidden and not shown on the home screen.
banner.saveFirst: Save the title first, then add an image.
